noRegistration: Accounts are created by the property management. There is no sign-up.
passwordSetDone: Password saved. You can log in now.
totpHint: Code from your authenticator app (e.g. Aegis, Google Authenticator, 1Password).
adminMust2fa: Two-factor authentication is mandatory for admin accounts.
enrollStep2: Scan the QR code or enter the key manually.
qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
forgotIntro: Enter your e-mail address. If an account exists, we will send you a link (valid for 1 hour).
passwordRules: At least 12 characters. Known leaked passwords are rejected.
linkInvalid: This link is invalid or has expired.
inviteIntro: Hi {name}, set your password to activate your account.
inviteInvalid: This invitation is invalid, expired or has already been used. Please contact the property management.
